scoring.note_it: Application thresholds: Relevance 16/30; Design 12/25; Partnerships 12/25; Impact 10/20. No IDEA scoring or subpoint weighting; IDs are internal, not official. Ex aequo: Relevance, then Quality of the project design and implementation, then Impact.
